rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese name for the ancient Greek city associated with the ancient Olympic Games.

example.english: Olympia in ancient Greece was the birthplace of the ancient Olympic Games.
example.traditional: 古希臘嘅奧林匹亞係古代奧運會嘅發源地。
